classification: REAL LOCAL SQL worker body with current snapshot/worker dependencies; fictional records. Cron log pruning uses fixture cron tables; scheduler API/dispatch not locally exercised.
checks: Worker delivers at most25 and leaves remaining queued work without changing specimens
Next run finishes backlog once without duplicate credit
Reconciliation and delivery each obey the25-row bound
Another active worker causes a non-blocking busy result
Paused worker performs neither reconciliation nor delivery and resumes safely
Drain only delivers pre-admitted work and never reconciles new captures
Closed recording yields no worker writes
Health reports exhausted work and the worker does not silently retry terminal rows
Browser and service roles cannot invoke the owner-only worker
Job-log pruning is bounded1000, older-than7-days and limited to this exact job
limitations: No live worker, reconciliation, delivery or cron job.
Cron activation/stop APIs are checked against hosted signatures/docs, not run as local pg_cron.
No alerting service is provisioned; operator health query exposes terminal/errors.
